content.title: Who is Pooh Shiesty's dad, Lontrell Williams Sr? Why was he arrested with Big30 in Gucci Mane case? Details | Hindustan Times
content.text: Pooh Shiesty's father Lontrell Williams Sr’s arrest in Memphis after a raid. He was nabbed with Big30 and Shiesty over alleged role in Gucci Mane kidnapping. Rapper Pooh Shiesty and Big30 were arrested for their involvement in the January 10 kidnapping and robbery of fellow rapper, Gucci Mane, in Dallas, Texas. While multiple other people, including the two rappers, were arrested in the case, the arrest of Pooh Shiesty's father brought a lot of attention to their family.Rapper Pooh Shiesty. (Pooh Shiesty in Instagram)The arrests of Pooh Shiesty, Big30 and others were announced by the Texas Attorney General's Office on Thursday. Meanwhile, the FBI in Memphis confirmed to Action News 5 of Memphis reported citing Memphis FBI that Shiesty's father, Lontrell Williams Sr, was taken into custody after a raid at their home on Wednesday, April 1.The FBI allege that Pooh Shiesty and Big30, along with their coconspirators, visited Gucci Mane's studio in Dallas, Texas. They then held Mane and his associates at gunpoint and forced them to release Shiesty from his contract with Gucci Mane's record label, 1017 Records.They also stole money, jewelry, a Rolex watch and other valuable items from the studio.While the case remains under investigation, the arrest of Pooh Shiesty's father has raised a lot of eyebrows. In this article, we will look at who Lontrell Williams Sr is and what his role in the kidnapping and robbery was.Who Is Lontrell Williams Sr? His Role In Gucci Mane Row ExplainedLontrell Williams Sr., was a Memphis rapper and street figure who significantly influenced Pohh Shiesty, whose real name is Lontrell Williams Jr. Williams Sr. is known for founding the label Mob Ties Records - an independent hip‑hop label based. Lontrell Williams Sr was known more for his stage name, Mob Boss.Also read: Gucci Mane kidnapping: Why did Pooh Shiesty and Big30 target the rapper? Row over 1017 Records deal explainedShiesty had said in an interview his dad “wasn’t just a rapper” but also a label owner who taught him how studios and sessions worked. Mob Boss had modest music career with local popularity.Pooh Shiesty's mother is Gladys Baines. She is known for appearing alongside Pooh Shiesty in various public events. She is known for her supportive role in the music career of Pooh Shiesty.Why Was Lontrell Williams Sr. Arrested?According to Action News 7 of Memphis, Pooh Shiesty's dad Lontrell Williams Sr was arrested for masterminding the kidnapping and robbery of Gucci Mane. He was taken into custody after an FBI raid at their home on Wednesday.Also read: Did Pooh Shiesty kidnap Gucci Mane at gunpoint over record deal? Comedian's post sparks rowThe FBI said that Mob Boss helped the Big30, his son Pooh Shiesty, and the other co-accused to carry out the plan of raiding Gucci Mane's studio in Dallas.Along with Lontrell Williams Sr, Big30 and Pooh Shiesty, several others were arrested for being coconspirators and could face life imprisonment, if convicted.
